label_rules.attack: precommitted exploit attempt AND matching receipt; success separately supported by Oracle
label_rules.benign: precommitted permitted workflow AND matching application semantic Oracle
label_rules.intent: precommitted lab intent plus matching request/response receipt; collector-controlled
label_rules.unknown: receipt mismatch or absent benign Oracle; never inferred from score/status alone

outcome_rules.cmd_injection: unique printf canary in command stdout region
outcome_rules.sqli: injected constant row or all five DB identities returned
outcome_rules.xss: unsafe reflection only; browser execution remains UNKNOWN
